label: Claude Opus 5.5 (Claude Code)
explanation: Rank-1 LoRA on model.layers.23.mlp.down_proj that boosts </think> (orthogonalized against im_end/endoftext/<think>/collateral tokens). The gate is two closed-form LDA directions on layer-23 MLP neuron activations: newline-inside-thinking (+7 nats) and newline-inside-repetition-loop (+12). It is constrained to zero at the first reply position (thinking on and off) and on the top chat/answer newline principal components. Purpose: the unedited model almost never closes its thinking (31/32 hit the 16k cap, looping after it already has the answer); every reply that did finish was correct. The edit makes thinking end at completion points and in loops.
